tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You and your classmates are planning a team-building retreat. You need to contact Ms. Taylor at a resort to ask some questions before you book.
bullets: Explain the purpose of the retreat and why you are considering this resort.
Ask about special dietary options for participants.
Inquire about recreational activities available at the resort.
tasks.subject: Team-building Retreat Resort Inquiry
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms. Taylor,

I am writing on behalf of my classmates. We are planning a weekend team-building retreat to help our project group work more effectively together, and your resort looks like a good fit because it is close to campus and has meeting rooms.

Could you tell us whether you offer special dietary options, such as vegetarian and allergy-friendly meals, for a group of about twenty students?

We would also like to know what recreational activities are available on site, for example hiking, swimming, or group games, so we can plan our schedule.

Thank you for your time. I look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
Alex Chen
tasks.analysis: 邮件需覆盖三点：说明团建目的与选择该度假村的原因、询问特殊饮食、询问康乐活动。称呼 Ms. Taylor。
tasks.title: Team-building Retreat Inquiry

tasks.instruction: Write a discussion response. An effective response contains at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: Next week, we will be discussing the importance of preserving indigenous cultures that were present a long time ago and survive today. Indigenous cultures face numerous challenges, including globalization and environmental changes. Some experts argue that preserving these cultures is vital. Others believe that adapting to modern society is equally important for the survival and prosperity of indigenous peoples. What are your thoughts on this issue?

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: Preserving indigenous cultures is essential for maintaining cultural diversity and historical knowledge. These cultures offer unique perspectives and wisdom that contribute to the richness of human heritage. Efforts should be made to protect their traditions and languages because the history of civilizations is often preserved by cultures with a long, storied past.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: While preserving cultural heritage is important, adapting to modern society is also crucial for the survival and prosperity of indigenous peoples. Integration into modern systems can provide additional resources for education, healthcare, and economic development. Indigenous peoples can be part of a modern society without sacrificing their history and culture.

tasks.sample: I agree with both Claire and Paul that preservation and adaptation can work together. Indigenous languages and traditions carry knowledge that the rest of the world cannot replace, so schools, museums, and community programs should support them. At the same time, people should not have to choose between keeping their culture and having education, healthcare, and jobs. Communities that control how they enter modern systems can use new tools to record languages and pass on stories. Globalization is a real pressure, but it does not have to erase identity if indigenous peoples lead the process of change.
tasks.analysis: 需表明立场并回应 Claire（保护）与 Paul（适应）。较好答法：两者结合，由原住民主导现代化进程。
tasks.title: Preserving Indigenous Cultures
